---
title: "Video Game Duration"
---

Welcome to **Video Game Duration**—exploring real-world completion times crowdsourced from [HowLongToBeat](https://howlongtobeat.com). Discover how long it takes to beat your favorite games across main stories, extra content, and 100% completionist runs.

```{=html}
<div class="row mb-4">
  <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
    <div class="metric-box">
      <h3 class="mb-1 text-info">3,100+</h3>
      <span class="text-secondary">Games Tracked</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
    <div class="metric-box">
      <h3 class="mb-1 text-warning">15.0 hrs</h3>
      <span class="text-secondary">Median Main Story</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="col-md-4 mb-3">
    <div class="metric-box">
      <h3 class="mb-1 text-danger">65.0 hrs</h3>
      <span class="text-secondary">Median 100% Completionist</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="mb-4">
  <input type="text" id="gameSearch" class="form-control form-control-lg" placeholder="🔍 Search games by title, platform, or year..." onkeyup="filterGames()" style="background-color: #2b2b2b; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #444444;">
</div>

<script>
function filterGames() {
  const query = document.getElementById('gameSearch').value.toLowerCase();
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.game-col');
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
    card.style.display = text.includes(query) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}
</script>
```

## Featured Games

Browse popular titles below, filter with the search bar, or explore deep trends in the [Story](story.qmd) tab and the full catalog in [Exploration](exploration.qmd).

```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

library(tidyverse)

# Load data and select top popular games
games <- read_csv("howlongtobeat.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(main_story_hours), !is.na(completionist_hours)) |>
  mutate(pop = count_comp + count_backlog) |>
  arrange(desc(pop)) |>
  slice_head(n = 24)

# Generate responsive Bootstrap cards
cards <- games |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(card = paste0(
    '<div class="col-12 col-md-6 col-lg-4 mb-4 game-col">',
    '  <div class="card game-card h-100 p-3">',
    '    <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2">',
    '      <h5 class="card-title mb-0 text-white" style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600;">', game_name, '</h5>',
    '      <span class="badge-score" title="Review Score">★ ', review_score, '</span>',
    '    </div>',
    '    <p class="text-secondary small mb-3">', release_year, ' &bull; ', platforms, '</p>',
    '    <div class="mt-auto pt-2 border-top border-secondary">',
    '      <div class="d-flex flex-wrap">',
    '        <span class="playtime-badge badge-story">Main: ', round(main_story_hours, 1), 'h</span>',
    if_else(!is.na(main_extra_hours), paste0('<span class="playtime-badge badge-extras">+Extras: ', round(main_extra_hours, 1), 'h</span>'), ''),
    '        <span class="playtime-badge badge-comp">100%: ', round(completionist_hours, 1), 'h</span>',
    '      </div>',
    '    </div>',
    '  </div>',
    '</div>'
  )) |>
  pull(card)

cat('```{=html}\n<div class="row" id="gameGrid">\n')
cat(paste(cards, collapse = "\n"))
cat('\n</div>\n```')
```
